text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Duramente-san. Is something the 
matter? I've felt your gaze on me... for a 
little while now.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
...I heard it's your birthday. Happy 
birthday.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my~! Thank you so much! I am so, soooo 
very happy!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, today really is a wonderful day! 
Getting celebrated by everyone, and by 
Duramente-san too!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Oh yes, I also received plenty of PreFie 
merchandise! If you'd like, perhaps later 
you could take a look—

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"...I don't have a present... but. I do 
have time."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"Running together, or other sports... I 
have plenty of time to join you. ...What 
do you want to do?"

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
! My... My, my, my! What a wonderful 
invitation. This is truly the best 
birthday present ever!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Is that so? Will this... work as a 
present?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Of course! After all, I get to spend time 
with you! Ehehe. I'm so happy~!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
If that's the case, then that's fine. 
...Happy birthday, Kawakami.
